preconditions.description: The number of people in the tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= n or ri == 0 for ri in r)
preconditions.description: Each parent index must be a valid person index or 0 if the person has no parent.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m space-separated integers corresponding to the answers of the queries.
Each output integer must be non-negative, representing the count of p-th cousins.
